assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production game-interface border, a single reusable nine-slice panel frame for an infernal volcanic fantasy roleplaying app. Create one square image, front-facing orthographic. The frame is four straight narrow rails of blackened wrought iron bar with a faceted, sharp-edged profile; a taut black iron chain of oval links runs along the middle of each rail, and short sharp iron spikes point outward at regular spacing. At each of the four corners a round black iron ring boss holding one faceted deep crimson gem that glows softly; each corner boss is circular and identical, with four short spikes around it. Thin slivers of glossy black volcanic glass (obsidian) inlaid along the rails catch a faint crimson reflection. Material depth, forged texture, soft dimensional highlights: the tactile artistic UI craft of a classic fantasy strategy game, not a flat vector border. Frame aligned square to the canvas, no perspective. Each rail stays narrow, within the outer 12 percent of the image; corner bosses may fill the outer 18 percent. Keep the middle stretches of all four rails simple and continuous so they can stretch in a responsive UI. BACKGROUND: the large rectangular central opening (the central 64 percent in each dimension) and the thin space outside the frame must be filled with perfectly flat, uniform pure magenta #FF00FF, with no texture, no shadow, no gradient and no ornaments crossing it, so it can be keyed out to transparency. Frame nearly fills the canvas with a 3 percent magenta outer margin; nothing cropped. Do not use magenta, pink or purple anywhere in the frame itself. Soft neutral top-left light; black iron, black glass, restrained deep crimson. No bronze, no brass, no gold, no silver tracery, no rivets, no stained glass, no orange. No skulls, no horns, no faces, no words, no letters, no runes that look like writing, no buttons, no icons, no scenery, no watermark.
